g.text: FR-17 — Build a personal agenda from natural language
with a note for every dropped session
More than 12 tool round trips → LangChain4j throws
a plain RuntimeException, which no handler maps
Full sessions are kept off the agenda by the prompt
only: verify() does not re-check availability.
a fresh AgendaTools with an empty dossier
system prompt + the attendee's own words
add the sessions to the dossier
return the tool results to the model
tools were called, and fewer than 12 round trips?
— the model's answer is checked in code
next proposed item, in the model's order
drop it, add a note naming the overlap
accept it with the model's rationale
